back_content.text: 结论：in the 1960s -> shipbuilding declined + private transport grew -> Subway ridership declined rapidly。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：In the 1960s, there was a decline in the shipbuilding industry, and the popularity of private transport grew. As a result, the Subway saw a rapid decline in ridership.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：in the 1960s 是时间节点；decline in the shipbuilding industry 和 popularity of private transport grew 是原因；As a result 后面是结果。② 核心规律：时间因果题要把“何时 + 为什么 + 导致什么”三件事绑在一起，而不是只记住 1896 或 1960s 这样的年份。③ 验证与迁移：听到 as a result / therefore / this led to 时，立刻回看前一句原因，并把结果单独标出来。
tips: 时间因果题先找时间，再找原因，最后找结果。
As a result 后面的信息通常是答案重心，不是背景铺垫。

back_content.text: 答案：B。两项变化共同造成 Subway ridership fell sharply。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：During the 1960s, shipbuilding jobs declined across Glasgow, and more residents began to rely on private cars. Together, these changes meant fewer workers used the Subway for daily travel, so its ridership fell sharply.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：shipbuilding jobs declined 和 more residents relied on private cars 是两个并列原因；Together 提示它们合并产生结果；so 后面是最终后果。② 干扰项分析：A 把“下降”偷换成“扩张”；C 是无中生有的交通系统变化；D 夸大为 workers relocated away。③ 验证与迁移：遇到 together / combined / this meant，要把前面的多个原因合并理解，再找 so / led to 后面的结果。
tips: Together 是多原因合并信号，后面通常接结果。
选项里出现方向相反的 expanded / improved，要先和原文的 fell sharply 核对。

back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Around the year 1450, a printing press using movable metal type was invented in Germany. By 1500, some twenty million volumes had already been printed. The immediate effect of printing was to increase the circulation of works that were already popular in handwritten form.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：Around 1450 是起点；By 1500 是结果已发生的截止时间；The immediate effect 明确标出直接后果。② 核心规律：转移题不只问单个年份，而是要求把时间推进和因果结果连成链。③ 验证与迁移：听到 by + year 时要理解为“到这个时间为止已经发生”，听到 immediate effect 时只回答直接结果，不扩展到后续文化影响。
tips: By 1500 表示截止时间，不是发明时间。
immediate effect 限定“直接后果”，不要把长期影响提前放进答案。
